<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">What Is an ITIN Number?</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">An Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) is a tax processing number issued by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS). It is a nine-digit number that always begins with the number 9 and has a range of 70-88 in the fourth and fifth digit.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Who Needs an ITIN?</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">The IRS issues ITINs to individuals who are required to have a U.S. taxpayer identification number but who do not have, and are not eligible to obtain, a Social Security Number (SSN).</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Common Reasons to Get an ITIN</h2>

<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Filing US taxes as a non-resident</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Opening US business bank accounts</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Forming a US LLC or corporation</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Selling on Amazon or other US platforms</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Freelancing for US clients</li>
<li class="ml-6 text-muted-foreground">Claiming tax treaty benefits</li>
